create.name: João Palma
create.bio:
João Palma is a Portuguese meditation teacher who has practised since 2004 and began teaching in 2008, both through Budadharma, the project he started that year, and at the Portuguese Buddhist Union in Lisbon. His roots are in the insight tradition of the Buddha's early teachings, and he has led meditation retreats since 2014. He is also a certified teacher and mentor of the eight-week MBSR programme, recognised by Bangor University and the UC San Diego Center for Mindfulness, and has helped train other mindfulness teachers in Portugal.

He lives with his partner, the yoga teacher Francisca Schouten, and their daughter at Casa Dhyana, a smallholding outside Monte da Caparica on the far bank of the Tagus from Lisbon. In the city he leads a lunchtime sitting on Tuesdays, open in person or on Zoom, and an online Thursday group for people who want to go further, each mixing a short reflection, guided practice and sharing. His courses and retreats work with satipaṭṭhāna, the four foundations of mindfulness, and the brahmavihāras of kindness, compassion, appreciative joy and equanimity, often in silence and with walking practice outdoors. Most classes are in Portuguese, and some retreats and the Budadharma site are offered in English.

courses.title: Mindfulness e os 4 Incomensuráveis
courses.description: A six-evening course in central Lisbon on the four qualities of the heart known in Buddhism as the brahmavihāras: kindness, compassion, appreciative joy and equanimity. Each session joins mindfulness and insight practice with guided audio for home practice; taught in Portuguese.

courses.title: Retiro de Silêncio – As 4 Fundações de Mindfulness
courses.description: A silent residential retreat at the Seminário da Silva near Barcelos, working through the four foundations of mindfulness from the Satipaṭṭhāna Sutta with guided vipassanā and mettā, talks and walking practice in nature. Some meditation experience is recommended.

courses.title: Sessões semanais de Mindfulness
courses.description: Two weekly groups he leads: a 50-minute lunchtime sitting on Tuesdays, in person in Lisbon or on Zoom, and an online Thursday evening session for those with some experience, combining a short reflection, guided meditation and group sharing.

courses.title: Iniciação ao Mindfulness
courses.description: A three-hour introductory workshop on how attention wanders, how to notice autopilot and how to bring mindfulness into formal sitting and daily life. Dates are announced on the page.
